notes.title: STEAM PAGE UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we're still working on the new version of the game, and we'll try to get out an awesome demo that you can play it .

While we're focusing on that, we thought that the old page of the game, here on steam did made justice for what we've been building, so we've update it with new images and a NEW AWESOME TRAILER.

And to not have anyone confused we've pulled down the old demo .

Enjoy the Trailer !

RISE Team
